data_objects.name: binary_feature_labels
data_objects.meaning: Row-level binary outcomes paired with two nullable binary-coded features.

variables.name: column_1
variables.meaning: Nullable binary-coded feature represented as 0.0 or 1.0.

variables.name: column_2
variables.meaning: Second nullable binary-coded feature represented as 0.0 or 1.0.

variables.name: label
variables.meaning: Binary outcome represented as floating-point 0.0 or 1.0.

structure.description: Each row is an independent two-feature label observation; the file supplies no explicit row identifier.

uncertainties: The business meanings of column_1, column_2, and the positive label are not documented.
annotation_notes: Blank CSV fields represent missing feature values and should not be merged with code 0.0.
